items.title: Sarandi (RS) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 24 #Chamamento público/ Credenciamento 6
items.en_title: Sarandi (RS) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 24 #Chamamento público/ Credenciamento 6
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Sarandi (RS) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 87,339.75; proposals close Nov 24, 17:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
